animations.name: Medium Punch Low
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Start from the exact supplied low kneeling crouch guard pose. Animate a heavy low crouching lunge punch spread smoothly across the clip, pure body motion only in completely empty air around the fighter: staying firmly anchored low in the kneeling crouch on the baseline without standing up, the fighter first coils back in clear anticipation; then he hunches his torso low forward with his back shoulder angled toward the viewer while driving a heavy straight right punch horizontally to the right (right arm fully extended parallel to the ground, fist closed, left arm tucked tightly back by his waist); after a brief clear hold at full extension, he smoothly retracts back into the exact starting crouching guard pose. Preserve exact face, beanie, black outfit, footwear, scale and pixel art. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, clean sprite only.
